darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Book the refund of Shopify order {recordKey} in NetSuite: Loop writes a credit memo for an online return, HotWax for a store or admin return.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite has no credit memo for the order

darpan.audit.AuditCheck.label: Rails Outlet Shopify returns refunded with no NetSuite credit memo
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.matchedBy: Shopify order id = custbody_rails_ext_order_id on the credit memo
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.headlineTemplate: Shopify order {recordKey} has a refunded return and no credit memo in NetSuite
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.fixActionTemplate: Book the refund of Shopify order {recordKey} in NetSuite: Loop writes a credit memo for an online return, HotWax for a store or admin return.
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.passesWhenTemplate: NetSuite has a credit memo for Shopify order {recordKey}.

darpan.rule.RuleSet.ruleSetName: Completed - HotWax vs NetSuite
darpan.rule.RuleSet.description: Every item HotWax completed must be billed on its NetSuite sales order line. Keyed (HotWax order id, item seq id).

darpan.rule.RuleSetCompareScope.description: Every item HotWax completed must be billed on its NetSuite sales order line. Keyed (HotWax order id, item seq id).

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: NetSuite closed the line HotWax completed: reopen and bill it in NetSuite, or cancel item {recordKey} in HotWax if it never shipped.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite closed the line

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Set the location on the NetSuite line of item {recordKey}; NetSuite can then ship and bill it.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite has the line, nothing shipped

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: The line has no location

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Fulfil the backordered line in NetSuite ({quantityBackordered} on backorder); it is billed once it ships.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite has the line

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: Nothing shipped, on backorder

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Bill the shipped line in NetSuite: it shipped and its sales order is not invoiced.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite shipped, not billed

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Send the fulfillment of item {recordKey} to NetSuite: HotWax fulfilled it and NetSuite still shows the line not shipped, so it cannot bill it.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite has the line, nothing shipped

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Nothing to fix in NetSuite: HotWax sends an order only once it is paid, and this one's payment was taken back (order total {orderGrandTotal}). It syncs once paid; cancel it in HotWax if the sale did not stand.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite has no line for the order

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_1
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: Its payment was taken back: the order total is 0

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Re-run the order sync in HotWax for item {recordKey}: NetSuite has no sales order for it.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite has no line for the order

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionRule.fixActionTemplate: Complete item {recordKey} in HotWax: NetSuite already billed it.

darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.subject: FILE_2
darpan.rule.RuleSetConclusionCondition.checkLabel: NetSuite billed the line

darpan.audit.AuditCheck.label: HotWax completed items against NetSuite billed lines
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.matchedBy: HotWax order id + item seq id (custbody_hc_order_id + custcol_hc_order_line_id)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.headlineTemplate: Item {recordKey} is completed in HotWax and not billed in NetSuite
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.fixActionTemplate: Bill the NetSuite line for item {recordKey}, or sync the order if NetSuite does not have it.
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.passesWhenTemplate: NetSuite has billed the line for item {recordKey}.
